verdicts.reason: comb bump / saddle behind the wrist
verdicts.why: the sheet's LEFT, RIGHT and 3/4 panels all draw the comb nose (X 157.5, Z 10.1) dropping to the wrist low (X 181.5, Z -1.3) and rising to the receiver; traced (spec buttstock.profile_top_M), stock side IoU is the authority. A straight comb is listed as a Fab-only change (fab_original_changes).

the plan taper 38.3 -> 31.9 mm (butt -> wrist) is the TOP trace and is the real narrowing at the wrist; round 1 already made the sections a swelling oval. Rounder sections (superellipse 2.8 / 2.55 / 2.35) were built and gated: the 3/4 gate's stock-top residual then read 'a width the TOP allows would fit' (unexplained, exception failed), so round 1's sections stay

verdicts.reason: no upper rear-trunnion tang; screw head on the wood
verdicts.fix: object rear_tang: conformal 1.6 mm steel strap over the wrist top X 208-225.22 (round rear end R 9.5, 0.25 proud, inletted 1.35, 0.3 edge break, 0.02 behind the trunnion face); the tang screw (slotted head r 3.0) sits on it at X 219; the stock inletted under it (tang_seat_cutter_obj). The sheet's TOP panel draws the strap-shaped patch round the screw.

verdicts.reason: dust cover smooth, no transverse stiffening ribs
verdicts.fix: six cross ribs pressed 0.8 INTO the top (top width 5.0, flat floor 3.2, ~42 deg flanks: crisp), X 296-426 pitch 26, across the top arc and fading over the shoulder to 0 at the vertical wall; the receiver's oval dimple is the stamped pattern whose thin cover carries lengthwise and transverse ribs; the sheet's 3/4 draws transverse lines near X ~316 / ~377. Pressed in, not out: ribs pressed out (built first) stood 0.8 above the traced top line, failed L4 (crown 33.5 vs 32.7) and moved the 3/4 camera solve so the rear-sight residual turned unexplained

verdicts.reason: cover a soft inflated lid (broad crown, rolled bulging sides)
verdicts.fix: section R 8 shoulders + R 48 top (rise 2.9) -> R 5 shoulders + R 90 top (rise 1.8); vertical skirt now to Z 26.03 (the lengthwise shoulder line); crown Z 32.7 and width 43.5 unchanged (key dims); the new cavity contains the old one (carrier clearances only grow)

verdicts.why: the rough-look steel's noise / speckle; the geometry is smooth lofted sheet. Texture stage.

verdicts.reason: pistol grip a straight uniform block, no rearward bow / palm swell
verdicts.why: the side outline is the sheet's traced grip (per-part L2 IoU); the real pattern's grip is a straight, near-uniform stick with a flared base (as built, H1 girth 125 mm in the real-grip range)

verdicts.reason: checkering a small rectangular patch like a decal
verdicts.why: the panel's outline and extent are c6's (long tapered panel from ~1/4 down to near the base), cut 0.70 deep at 1.8 mm pitch in a 0.75 recess with a crisp wall; its light flat read in the review is the plain wood shader without cavity -- the texture stage paints the cut cells #4E2E1E (spec)

verdicts.reason: lower retainer one band framing both handguards
verdicts.fix: handguard_front_band is now two pieces: the gas-tube collar round the upper guard (from Z 13.45) and the U ferrule round the lower guard with the barrel / rod holes (to Z 12.75), seam at the joint line; same X span and outer outline (side trace contour gate)

verdicts.why: 80.8 mm long on the traced main-view outline and c1 (L3 positions), one 2.0 mm stamped blade whose top edge (Z 8.0) closes the charging slot's rear on safe; the 'wedge' is c1's pressed step (0.35)

verdicts.reason: receiver rear a stepped box, overhang lip, taller / wider than the wrist
verdicts.verdict: REJECTED (sheet + real pattern); eased by the tang
verdicts.why: the TOP panel measures the wrist-wide block 34-35.6 mm back of X ~233 and 43-45 mm ahead (built 33.2 / 41.5); the side trace has the trunnion ledge at Z 7.8 and the 10.38 step under the cover's lip; the real trunnion is stepped. The new tang now carries the steel line from the trunnion over the wrist.

budget.savings: lower handguard section fillets only on its 2 top corners (52 -> 22 ring points, same shape: lower_handguard 2820 -> 1750); front band 2226 -> 1206 (two pieces, 32-gon holes); cover top arc 3 segments (R 90 spans 11.4 deg a side); cover ribs on the outer surface only (inner cavity smooth)
